name: nft-jump-nested-accept
description: jump into a chain that jumps on to one accepting the peer
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add chain inet f sub2
nft add rule inet f sub2 ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
nft add rule inet f sub jump sub2

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out jump sub
